assets.what: Elevation patch for the Salamis strait and its surroundings (lon 23.40-23.80, lat 37.84-38.08, 1104x864, ~30 m/px), 16-bit metres in the app's own (elev+11000)/20000 R/G encoding
assets.source: Terrain Tiles on AWS (Mapzen 'terrarium' tiles, zoom 12, tiles x2314-2318 y1578-1581), an AWS Open Data set; land heights from SRTM/EU-DEM, offshore from ETOPO1
assets.license: Public domain / CC0-equivalent per the Terrain Tiles on AWS attribution terms; underlying SRTM is US government public domain
assets.treatment: Mercator tiles mosaicked and resampled to an equirectangular grid; water cells (elev <= 0) floored to -8 m because the raster's nearshore bathymetry gap encodes harbour water as 0 m and a 0 m seabed breaks the rendered sea surface. The coastline - the 0-crossing - is the raster's own.

assets.what: Elevation patch for the Calais-Gravelines-Dunkirk coast (lon 1.55-2.55, lat 50.85-51.15, 2335x1111, ~30 m/px), 16-bit metres in the app's own (elev+11000)/20000 R/G encoding
assets.source: Terrain Tiles on AWS (Mapzen 'terrarium' tiles, zoom 12, tiles x2065-2077 y1368-1373), an AWS Open Data set; land heights from SRTM/EU-DEM, offshore from ETOPO1
assets.license: Public domain / CC0-equivalent per the Terrain Tiles on AWS attribution terms; underlying SRTM is US government public domain
assets.treatment: Mercator tiles mosaicked and resampled to an equirectangular grid by Research/bake-shore.py; water cells (elev <= 0) floored to -8 m; land components never reaching 2 m drowned as shoal noise (8368 cells, mostly the tidal Flemish banks, which the sea surface owns). The coastline - the 0-crossing - is the raster's own.

assets.name: File:Jan van Grevenbroeck - Venetian galleass.jpg
assets.caption: A Venetian galleass, drawn by Jan van Grevenbroeck in the eighteenth century for his manuscript on Venetian customs. No galleass survives; the type is known from drawings like this one, from Arsenal records, and from the battle accounts
assets.credit: [1], from Gli Abiti de' Veneziani di quasi ogni età con diligenza raccolti e dipinti nel secolo XVIII
